method.existence_constraint: one contiguous alive interval per slot, including never alive
method.base_distribution: exact normalized existence-prior times count density
method.mutation: reversible whole-frame association replacement, birth/death interval replacement with exact Hastings correction, and global slot swaps
method.label_treatment: exchangeable labelled slots; no first-frame anchor

gate_definition.association_and_mask_tv: at most max(0.05, 3 * exact-draw MC q95)
gate_definition.association_and_mask_js: at most max(0.01, 3 * exact-draw MC q95)
gate_definition.credible_set_recall_95: at least the fifth percentile of equal-size exact draws
gate_definition.exact_mass_covered: at least max(0.95, exact-draw fifth percentile)
gate_definition.masked_path_sliced_wasserstein: at most max(1 um, 3 * exact-draw baseline)
gate_definition.aggregate_rule: every repeat in every frozen regime must pass
